authority: Latest explicit owner instruction: use highest Gemini model; original repository selected.

sources.observation: Current index designates 3.8 Flash TTS as flagship speech and 4 Argon as flagship reasoning.

Interactions REST single-speaker request supplies transcript separately from speech_metadata style, voice config, and unary WAV response. Charon and Kore are listed. Default WAV is mono PCM16 at 24 kHz.
Supported inputs include audio; output is text. It supports structured outputs and high thinking.

Argon REST quickstart uses Interactions. Thinking configuration uses snake_case; maximum output includes reasoning. At least 32768 output tokens and a 15-minute HTTP timeout are recommended for existing applications.
Inline audio content supplies type audio, base64 data and mime_type; entire request must be below 20 MB.
Interactions response_format uses type text and mime_type application/json for JSON output.
GET v1beta/models/{id} retrieves server model metadata, including supported generation methods.

inference: Combine documented Argon audio-input support with documented Interactions inline-audio and JSON response formats. No model call was made during preparation.
fallback: None. Missing preferred model or unresolved supported methods stops before generation.
